// [key, english, translation, core(1 = Select Panelist/Build Survey sheet)]
  if (window.__l10nStop) window.__l10nStop();

  const norm = (s) => String(s || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().replace(/\s*[:：]\s*$/, '');
  const PH = /\{\{?\s*\w+\s*\}?\}/;
  const toRegex = (s) => new RegExp('^' + s.split(/\{\{?\s*\w+\s*\}?\}/).map((p) => p.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')).join('.+') + '$');

  const trExact = new Map(), trRegex = [], trPrefix = [], enExact = new Map(), enRegex = [], enPrefix = [];
  let coreTotal = 0;
  for (const [key, enRaw, trRaw, core] of ITEMS) {
    const en = norm(enRaw), tr = norm(trRaw);
    if (core) coreTotal++;
    if (tr) {
      if (PH.test(tr)) trRegex.push({ key, re: toRegex(tr) });
      else { if (!trExact.has(tr)) trExact.set(tr, key); if (tr.length >= 6) trPrefix.push({ key, text: tr }); }
    }
    if (en && en !== tr) {
      if (PH.test(en)) enRegex.push({ key, re: toRegex(en), expected: trRaw });
      else { if (!enExact.has(en)) enExact.set(en, { key, expected: trRaw }); if (en.length >= 8) enPrefix.push({ key, en, expected: trRaw }); }
    }
  }
  const info = new Map(ITEMS.map((x) => [x[0], { en: x[1], tr: x[2], core: x[3] }]));
  const seen = new Set();

  const isVisible = (el) => {
    if (!el || !el.getClientRects || el.getClientRects().length === 0) return false;
    const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
    return cs.visibility !== 'hidden' && cs.display !== 'none';
  };
  const collect = () => {
    const out = [];
    const walk = (root) => {
      const tw = document.createTreeWalker(root, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
      let n;
      while ((n = tw.nextNode())) {
        const el = n.parentElement;
        if (!el || /^(SCRIPT|STYLE|NOSCRIPT|TEMPLATE)$/.test(el.tagName)) continue;
        const t = norm(n.textContent);
        if (t && /\p{L}/u.test(t) && isVisible(el)) out.push({ text: t, el, where: 'text' });
      }
      root.querySelectorAll('*').forEach((el) => {
        for (const a of ['placeholder', 'title', 'aria-label']) {
          const t = norm(el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute(a));
          if (t && /\p{L}/u.test(t) && isVisible(el)) out.push({ text: t, el, where: a });
        }
        if (el.shadowRoot) walk(el.shadowRoot);
      });
    };
    walk(document.body);
    return out;
  };

  let marked = [];
  const clear = () => { marked.forEach(([el, o]) => (el.style.outline = o)); marked = []; };
  const mark = (el, style) => { marked.push([el, el.style.outline]); el.style.outline = style; };

  const screens = [];
  let lastSig = '', stable = 0, lastPrinted = '';

  const scan = () => {
    clear();
    const ok = new Map(), english = new Map(), raw = new Map(), unknown = new Map();
    for (const f of collect()) {
      const t = f.text;
      if (/SURVEYMOD_[A-Z0-9_]+/.test(t) || /^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+(\.[A-Z0-9_]+)+$/.test(t)) { raw.set(t, f); continue; }
      let key = trExact.get(t);
      if (!key) { const r = trRegex.find((x) => x.re.test(t)); if (r) key = r.key; }
      if (!key) { const pf = trPrefix.find((x) => t.startsWith(x.text + ' ') || t.startsWith(x.text + ':')); if (pf) key = pf.key; }
      if (key) { ok.set(t, { ...f, key }); seen.add(key); continue; }
      const hit = enExact.get(t) || enRegex.find((x) => x.re.test(t)) || enPrefix.find((x) => t.startsWith(x.en + ' ') || t.startsWith(x.en + ':'));
      if (hit) { english.set(t, { ...f, key: hit.key, expected: hit.expected }); seen.add(hit.key); continue; }
      unknown.set(t, f);
    }
    ok.forEach((f) => mark(f.el, '2px solid #1db954'));
    english.forEach((f) => mark(f.el, '3px solid red'));
    raw.forEach((f) => mark(f.el, '3px solid red'));
    return { ok, english, raw, unknown };
  };

  const coreSeen = () => [...seen].filter((k) => info.get(k) && info.get(k).core).length;

  const tick = () => {
    const r = scan();
    const sig = [...r.ok.keys(), '|', ...r.english.keys(), '|', ...r.unknown.keys()].join('~') + location.pathname;
    if (sig === lastSig) stable++; else { stable = 0; lastSig = sig; }
    if (stable !== 1 || sig === lastPrinted) return;
    lastPrinted = sig;
    const segs = (location.pathname.split('/survey')[1] || '').split('/').filter(Boolean);
    const flow = segs.length === 0 ? 'Home (out of scope)' : segs.includes('aiflow') ? 'Start with prompt' : 'Start from scratch';
    const screen = segs.filter((s) => s !== 'aiflow').join('/') || 'home';
    const name = `${flow} | ${screen} #${screens.length + 1}`;
    screens.push({ name, flow, screen, ok: r.ok.size, okTexts: [...r.ok.keys()], english: [...r.english.values()], raw: [...r.raw.keys()], unknown: [...r.unknown.keys()] });
    console.log(`%c[${TAG}] ${name} | ✅ ${r.ok.size} | ❌ ${r.english.size + r.raw.size} English/raw | ❔ ${r.unknown.size} not in sheet | core seen ${coreSeen()}/${coreTotal}`, 'font-weight:bold;font-size:13px');
    if (r.english.size) { console.log('%c❌ Still English (should be ' + CODE + '):', 'color:red;font-weight:bold'); console.table([...r.english.values()].map((f) => ({ Text: f.text, Key: f.key, Expected: f.expected, Where: f.where }))); }
    if (r.raw.size) { console.log('%c❌ Raw keys on screen:', 'color:red;font-weight:bold'); console.table([...r.raw.keys()].map((t) => ({ Text: t }))); }
    if (r.unknown.size) { console.log('%c❔ Not in the sheet (no outline) - check by eye; data like dataset names is fine:', 'color:#c80;font-weight:bold'); console.table([...r.unknown.values()].map((f) => ({ Text: f.text, Where: f.where }))); }
  };

  const timer = setInterval(tick, 1500);
  tick();

  const left = () => ITEMS.filter((x) => x[3] && !seen.has(x[0]));
  window.__l10nLeft = () => { const l = left(); console.log(`[${TAG}] core sheet texts not seen yet: ${l.length}/${coreTotal}`); console.table(l.map((x) => ({ Key: x[0], English: x[1], [CODE]: x[2] }))); };
  window.__l10nStop = () => { clearInterval(timer); clear(); console.log(`[${TAG}] stopped`); };
  window.__l10nClear = clear;
  window.__l10nTotal = () => {
    const eng = new Map(), unk = new Set();
    screens.forEach((s) => { s.english.forEach((f) => eng.set(f.text, { Text: f.text, Expected: f.expected, Screen: s.name })); s.raw.forEach((t) => eng.set(t, { Text: t, Expected: '(raw key)', Screen: s.name })); s.unknown.forEach((t) => unk.add(t)); });
    console.log(`%c[${TAG} TOTAL] screens ${screens.length} | still English ${eng.size} | not in sheet ${unk.size} | core seen ${coreSeen()}/${coreTotal}`, 'font-weight:bold;font-size:13px');
    if (eng.size) console.table([...eng.values()]);
  };
  window.__l10nCopy = () => {
    const L = [];
    const flows = ['Start from scratch', 'Start with prompt', 'Home (out of scope)'];
    L.push(`${CODE} CHECK RESULT | ${new Date().toISOString()} | screens: ${screens.length} | core sheet texts seen: ${coreSeen()}/${coreTotal}`);
    L.push('', '##### PROBLEMS (tab-separated): Flow / Screen / Actual / Expected / Key');
    L.push(['Flow', 'Screen', 'Actual (shows)', 'Expected (sheet)', 'Key'].join('\t'));
    const dup = new Set();
    flows.forEach((fl) => screens.filter((s) => s.flow === fl).forEach((s) => {
      s.english.forEach((f) => { const k = fl + s.screen + f.text; if (dup.has(k)) return; dup.add(k); L.push([fl, s.screen, f.text, f.expected, f.key].join('\t')); });
      s.raw.forEach((x) => { const k = fl + s.screen + x; if (dup.has(k)) return; dup.add(k); L.push([fl, s.screen, x, '(raw key shown)', ''].join('\t')); });
    }));
    L.push('', `##### CORE SHEET TEXTS NEVER SEEN (${left().length}) - still to trigger/check: Key / English / ${CODE}`);
    left().forEach((x) => L.push([x[0], x[1], x[2]].join('\t')));
    flows.forEach((fl) => {
      const list = screens.filter((s) => s.flow === fl);
      if (!list.length) return;
      L.push('', `##### FLOW: ${fl}`);
      list.forEach((s) => {
        L.push('', `=== ${s.name} | matched ${s.ok} | English/raw ${s.english.length + s.raw.length} | not in sheet ${s.unknown.length}`);
        L.push('-- MATCHED (green):'); s.okTexts.forEach((t) => L.push('   ' + t));
        L.push('-- NOT IN SHEET (no outline; includes data like dataset names):'); s.unknown.forEach((t) => L.push('   ' + t));
      });
    });
    const text = L.join('\n');
    try { const ta = document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value = text; ta.style.position = 'fixed'; ta.style.opacity = '0'; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.focus(); ta.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); ta.remove(); } catch (e) {}
    try { const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([text], { type: 'text/plain' })); a.download = 'l10n-' + TAG.toLowerCase() + '-result.txt'; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); } catch (e) {}
    console.log(`[${TAG}] result copied and saved as l10n-${TAG.toLowerCase()}-result.txt (${screens.length} screens)`);
  };
  console.log(`%c[${TAG}] watching ${CODE}. Click through the flow. __l10nLeft() = what is still unchecked, __l10nCopy() = export.`, 'color:#1db954;font-weight:bold');
})();
